items.title: Amazon earnings: AWS's growth rate 'no doubt' justifies the big AI spending
items.summary: Amazon (AMZN) reported second quarter earnings results that beat Wall Street's expectations. CFRA Research senior vice president of equity research, Arun Sundaram, chats with Yahoo Finance about his expectations for AWS.

items.title: Where Apple is diverging from rest of Mag 7 earnings
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) stock continues to drop on Friday while shares of Amazon (AMZN) surge since the two tech giants posted earnings results yesterday. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Breaking News Reporter Jake Conley and Trustless Media Founder Zack Guzman take a closer look at the key figures that Apple reported in its earnings release.

items.title: Apple CEO Tim Cook says this '100-year flood' won't be receding anytime soon
items.summary: Memory chip supply constraints remain a problem for Apple.

items.title: Amazon CEO: AWS could be a 'trillion-dollar' business
items.summary: Amazon (AMZN) CEO Andy Jassy explained on the company's earnings call that while the company expects to spend approximately '$220 billion in cash capex in 2026' to meet soaring demand, he believes AWS could 'very possibly be a trillion-dollar annual revenue business for us in time.'

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow, Nasdaq End Higher Despite Spiking Yields; Amazon Soars
items.summary: Stock Market Today: The Dow Jones index rises Friday even as Apple dives on a weak sales forecast. Amazon stock surges on earnings.

items.title: Wall Street Rushes to Raise Amazon Targets After 15% Post-Earnings Stock Surge
items.summary: Analysts raised Amazon price targets to as high as $400 after AWS growth of 37% drove a 15% single day surge.
